subject: general
question:
Identify the figure given in the options which when put in place of ? will logically complete the series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e5ede4e12c009171f1aadcefb1dad571d4ac6088f99b9c0b07b4580a552fcc70.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) The top element shifts clockwise to immediate right section subsequently.

2) The bottom element shifts clockwise to immediate left section subsequently.

3) The bottom element is replaced by new element subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fd166240c645c489faff22134f469387f500ed18043e3ab002fbfb5943c36b3d.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6bd8e50690c826354c6855db136bea23a827eeacacfe37178ef3358331596056.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca56bf1de2a6d549242b0ba74191c809a33efe33e3dccd9eb5ccd74edb755b97.png] 

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
